scope: Text provenance carrier extraction only; no signing or cleanup.
Bounded Linux/amd64 feasibility only; no accepted production capability.

prerequisites.detail: G2 #37 scoped four Go extraction APIs. HTML host validation and source mappings remain prerequisites alongside executable DA-001/report integration; no accepted extraction adapter.

licenses_notices.detail: Root MIT retained and x/text BSD-3-Clause inspected; no upstream code or vectors redistributed. Per-file/transitive notices and production redistribution clearance remain open.

unit_contract.detail: 28 upstream tests passed; 39 independent cases completed with eight HTML host-context mismatches. These probes do not establish production normalization or adapter conformance.

live_adapter.detail: No DA-001 extraction adapter executed; ExtractManifest/ValidateText/ExtractStructured/ExtractHTML probes are feasibility evidence only.

source_integrity.detail: Synthetic input hashes checked after every case. Decomposed-text raw/NFC offsets differ and structured/HTML APIs omit spans; production acquisition and source mapping remain unvalidated.

adversarial_fuzz.detail: 39 cases cover malformed VS wrappers, huge lengths, multiple carriers, Unicode coordinates and HTML host confusion. Eight HTML mismatches remain; no production fuzz campaign completed.

resources.detail: Build/upstream tests used 23.945 CPU seconds and 416.7 MiB peak memory; case run 0.265 CPU seconds and 153.3 MiB. Linux harness enforced 1 GiB memory and per-case deadlines; no production worst-case bound.

native_platforms.detail: Go 1.27.1 Linux/amd64 extraction study only. No other native detector platform executed; core cross-build CI is not evidence for these APIs.

build_install.detail: Two fresh offline Go probe builds and corpus runs yielded identical binary/result bytes. This does not establish cross-host reproducibility, install/relocation or accepted release packaging.

disable_rollback_missing.detail: No installed extraction adapter; disable, missing-runtime and rollback behavior in native audits remains untested.

security_updates.detail: Carrier pin and x/text dependency identified, but no complete advisory, per-file notice or supported-update review for extraction adoption.

semantic_upgrade.detail: 39-case carrier baseline is retained, including eight unresolved HTML discrepancies; no accepted baseline, replacement pin comparison or rollback drill yet.

evidence.purpose: Observed results, environment and residual limitations
Exact retained experiment artifacts, toolchain and result identities
Reproducible pinned provisioning and offline commands

limitations: Eight of 39 independent HTML cases disagree with expected host syntax/context.
NFC derivative coordinates differ from raw input; structured/HTML APIs omit source spans.
Passing 28 upstream tests does not establish production interoperability.
next_actions: Finish report wire and executable adapter contract gates under #36.
Scope extraction APIs and define format-aware host validation and source mappings.
Obtain reviewed production test/platform/resource and license/security plans before adoption.
